forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: ffaa80
+title: delete the five orphan Rust modules nothing compiles
+---
+The `dead-code-rust` tool rule's orphan-module scan (^0v7nysz) found five `.rs` files in this workspace that no `mod` declaration names, so nothing compiles them. Every one was hand-checked and every one is real:
+
+- [ ] `crates/swissarmyhammer/src/security.rs` — 15 KB of path-validation and resource-limit code nothing compiles
+- [ ] `crates/markdowndown/src/error.rs`
+- [ ] `crates/markdowndown/src/fetch.rs`
+- [ ] `crates/swissarmyhammer-common/src/sample_avp_test.rs`
+- [ ] `crates/swissarmyhammer-tools/src/mcp/notifications.rs` — an empty file
+
+Reproduce with the `dead-code-rust` rule's own script, or by hand:
+
+```sh
+grep -rn 'mod security\b' crates/swissarmyhammer --include='*.rs'
+```
+
+For each file, decide: wire it in with a `mod` declaration, or delete it. A file nothing compiles has no suppression available — naming it is the only fix, and deleting it is the other.
+
+The rule reports only findings in changed files, so these five never block a review until someone touches the file. That is why they are their own card.
+
+#tool-validators #dead-code
\ No newline at end of file
